machine.nproc_note: GNU nproc honours OMP_NUM_THREADS, so `nproc` can print 1 on a multi-core host; `nproc_all` is the core count.
machine.thread_env_note: NPROC sizes XLA's CPU intra-op pool (the JAX rows); the BLAS knobs pin OpenBLAS/MKL/OpenMP (the numpy/scipy rows) and do not touch JAX. Two disjoint families; both are recorded on every CPU timing.

protocol.route_order: round-robin over every config, start rotated each round
protocol.cache_trap_guard: fresh closure + fresh solver/analysis per route; jax.clear_caches()
protocol.admissible: 100% distinct-multiplicity agreement with the reference on the prior draws AND max position error <= 0.002"
protocol.prior_draws: full prior: vector_from_unit_vector(U(1e-4, 1-1e-4)); source = solved beta*
protocol.stress_draws: OUTSIDE the prior: Isothermal centre U(-0.05,0.05), theta_E U(1,2), ell_comps U(-0.2,0.2), source centre U(-0.4,0.4); plain FitPositionsImagePairAll positions
protocol.max_containing_size_patch: ArrayTriangles.__init__ / for_limits_and_scale __defaults__ + module constant, tracing only, restored by value
protocol.pytrees: autofit.jax.register_model(model) for both models before any trace

extent_working: prior: theta_E <= 1.6 + 4*0.05 = 1.8; |e| <= 0.0526 + 4*0.01 ~ 0.09 -> q ~ 0.83; SIE images lie within ~theta_E/sqrt(q) + |beta| ~ 1.98 + 0.1 ~ 2.1 arcsec of the centre, so boxes of +-6 / +-4 / +-3 / +-2.5 bracket it; reference_image_extent is the measured value

control.method: prefix medians; ray_trace = jnp.sum(plane.vertices) minus source_centre; containment = containing_indices minus ray_trace (includes the vertices[indices] gather + Point.mask + jnp.where) and is the headline before/after number; route_input_materialisation = the route's six barycentric input components returned as outputs (captured at trace time) minus ray_trace; general_gather_reference = plane.triangles minus ray_trace, route-independent

mcs20.method: prefix medians; ray_trace = jnp.sum(plane.vertices) minus source_centre; containment = containing_indices minus ray_trace (includes the vertices[indices] gather + Point.mask + jnp.where) and is the headline before/after number; route_input_materialisation = the route's six barycentric input components returned as outputs (captured at trace time) minus ray_trace; general_gather_reference = plane.triangles minus ray_trace, route-independent

mcs_headroom.decision_rule: smallest N >= 18 with uncapped max <= N - 3, no unexplained change, compile <= +20 %, scalar median cost <= ~5 % (human picks N at the step-2 checkpoint)
